candidate_relations.reason: The reference is idiopathic pulmonary arterial hypertension with a patent foramen ovale, whereas the candidate attributes PAH causally to congenital heart disease. A PFO is present but is not established here as the cause of the PAH.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Conflicting PAH etiology and omission of the specific PFO/right-to-left shunt component.
